title: molt doctor reports GitHub not authenticated when the ssh handshake is slower than its 5 s timeout
body:
`molt doctor`'s GitHub auth check (`lib/molt.sh`, the `timeout 5 ssh -T git@github.com` line) reports "not authenticated" when the ssh handshake takes longer than five seconds, even though authentication works. It reads timing out the same as being refused.

kovacs-sysadm found this on 26 Oct 2026. From kovacs the handshake took about 6 s, so doctor counted the check as not passed on every run. Meanwhile ssh answered "Hi matthewsinclair!" and gh was logged in. The same check had passed that morning, so it depends on the route and its latency, not on the sleeve's setup.

To fix it, give ssh its own connect bound instead of a short outer kill: eg `ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 -T git@github.com`, under an outer timeout long enough to finish an authenticated handshake. A timeout must report as unreachable ("could not reach github.com within N s"), not "not authenticated", so the verdict says what was checked. Tests cover three cases: a stub ssh that answers late but within the bound passes; one that never answers reports the timeout, not "not authenticated"; one that answers "Permission denied" reports not authenticated.


## Deferral (hv, 28 Oct 2026, through molt-vc)

hv: "yes, defer 0069 and 0071". Deferred past the next Molt release, in hv's issue cull of 28 Oct. It is not built in this cycle.


## Deferral lifted (hv, 30 Oct 2026, through molt-vc)

vc decision 36: Molt 1.2.0 carries 0069.

## As built (dc, 30 Oct 2026; merged by vc at 6a68d33)

- `lib/constants.sh`: `MOLT_GITHUB_CONNECT_TIMEOUT` (10) and `MOLT_GITHUB_TIMEOUT` (20).
- `lib/molt.sh`: `molt_github_auth_check` runs `ssh -n -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 -T git@github.com`, under `timeout 20` where a `timeout` is installed (macOS has none in /usr/bin), else bare. The pure `molt_github_auth_verdict` reads the answer: authenticated as the user ssh names; "could not reach github.com within N s" for timeout's 124 (the outer bound) or ssh's own "timed out" (the connect bound); otherwise not authenticated. `cmd_doctor` calls it. At the merge, lib/molt.sh's one conflict, with issue 0067's new function, kept both (vc).
- README and `docs/guides/getting-started.md` say `timeout` is optional for doctor. `bin/bootstrap.sh`'s own copy of the check (`timeout 5 ssh -n -T`), which cannot source lib/, stays as it is (vc).
- Tests (`test/molt.bats`, `GitHub`): an answer after 1 s passes (a guard); ssh gets `-n`, BatchMode and ConnectTimeout; an ssh that never answers reports the outer bound; a connect that times out reports the connect bound; "Permission denied" reports not authenticated (a guard). The three new tests failed before the fix, under bash 5.3 and /bin/bash 3.2.
